name: Shipjoy Free Shipping Bar For WooCommerce
author: Elenova Digital

sections.description:
Free Shipping Bar and progress bar for WooCommerce

Shipjoy Free Shipping Bar and progress bar for WooCommerce helps you increase your average order value by showing customers how close they are to qualifying for free shipping. This powerful yet simple free shipping bar plugin displays a beautiful progress bar that motivates shoppers to add more items to their cart.

🎯 Key Features of Free Shipping Bar Plugin

  • Free Shipping Bar – Show Free shipping bar to encourage more sales
  • Full Customisation Setup of Shipping Bar – Customize Colors, Texts, Display locations and more
  • Customizable Progress Bar – Show progress toward free shipping threshold
  • Flexible Positioning – Place Shipping bar at top or bottom of the page
  • Custom Messages – Personalize messages for different cart states
  • Auto-Detection – Automatically detects free shipping zones from WooCommerce
  • Manual Override – Set custom minimum amounts if needed
  • Beautiful Design – Modern, responsive interface that matches any theme
  • Shortcode Support – Dynamic content with built-in shortcodes to match with woocommerce
  • No Coding Required – Easy-to-use admin interface
  • Initial Delay Setup – Set Delay Time of shipping bar to your needs
  • Full Responsive – Works on all display sizes

📊 Display Locations

The plugin shows progress bars in strategic locations:

  • Top/Bottom shipping Bar – Notification bar across your entire site
  • Cart Page – Full progress display on the cart page (Pro)
  • Checkout Page – Reminder on checkout to add more items (Pro)

🎨 Customization Options

Design Settings:

  • Bar background color
  • Text color
  • Link color
  • Price color
  • Font size and alignment
  • Progress bar colors

Message Templates:
* Announce message (empty cart)
* After add message (items in cart)
* Not reached message (below threshold)
* Goal reached message (free shipping unlocked)

🔧 Available Shortcodes

Use these shortcodes in your custom messages:

  • {min_amount} – Minimum amount for free shipping
  • {total_amounts} – Current cart total
  • {cart_amount} – Current cart subtotal
  • {missing_amount} – Amount needed to reach goal
  • {checkout_page} – Link to checkout page
  • {shopping} – Link to continue shopping

💎 Pro Features

Upgrade to Shipjoy Pro for advanced features:

  • Animated Progress Effects – Eye-catching animations for progress bar
  • Sticky Bar Option – Keep free shipping bar visible while scrolling
  • Box Shadow Effects – Add depth to your shipping bar
  • Hover Animations – Interactive hover effects
  • Entrance Animations – Smooth bar appearance
  • Custom CSS – Advanced styling options
  • Multiple Locations – Cart and checkout page displays
  • Shortcode Support – Place bars anywhere with shortcodes
  • Priority Support – Get help when you need it
  • Text Animation Effects – Get Text Animation Effects
  • Hide On pages – Hide Free Shipping Bar on Specific Pages
  • More Font Support – Get More Fonts for your free shipping bar

Upgrade to Pro →

🚀 How Our Free Shipping Bar Works

  1. Install and activate the shipjoy Free shipping and progress bar plugin
  2. Plugin automatically detects your free shipping zones
  3. Customize colors and messages to match your brand
  4. The progress bar appears automatically across your site
  5. Customers see how close they are to free shipping
  6. Watch your average order value increase!

🎯 Perfect For

  • Online stores wanting to increase average order value
  • Shops offering free shipping thresholds
  • WooCommerce stores of any size
  • Stores wanting to reduce cart abandonment
  • Anyone looking to boost conversions

🌍 Translation Ready

The plugin is fully translation-ready and includes:
* POT file for easy translation
* RTL language support
* Multilingual compatibility

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. It only uses WooCommerce cart information that is already available in your WordPress installation.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Shipjoy Free Shipping Bar”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to Shipjoy in your admin menu to configure settings

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Go to Shipjoy in your admin menu to configure settings

Configuration

  1. Go to Free Shipping Bar in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Enable the shipping bar
  3. Choose bar position (top or bottom)
  4. Select your free shipping zone or set a custom minimum amount
  5. Customize colors to match your brand
  6. Edit messages using available shortcodes
  7. Choose display locations (mini cart, cart, checkout)
  8. Save your settings and you’re done!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

How does the plugin detect free shipping amounts?

The plugin automatically detects free shipping zones configured in WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping. You can also manually override the amount in the plugin settings.

Can I customize the messages?

Absolutely! You can customize all messages and use dynamic shortcodes to show amounts, cart totals, and links.

Will this work with my theme?

Yes! The plugin is designed to work with any WordPress theme. You can customize colors to match your brand perfectly.

Can I show the bar in multiple locations?

Yes, you can display progress bars in the mini cart, and with Pro version, also on cart and checkout pages.

Does it work with AJAX add to cart?

Yes! The plugin updates dynamically when items are added to the cart using AJAX.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation-ready with a .pot file included for easy translation.

What if I have multiple shipping zones?

You can select which shipping zone to use, or let the plugin automatically detect the first free shipping zone.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes! Shipjoy Pro includes animations, sticky bars, box shadows, custom CSS, and more display locations. Learn more →

How do I get support?

For free version support, please use the WordPress support forum. Pro users get priority email support.
